title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
original_title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
plot_overview: After a landmark Rose Bowl performance, a celebrated college football star becomes one of the NFL’s most anticipated players. His journey takes a more difficult turn as injuries, conflict, fame, and personal loss complicate the success promised by his early achievements.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this documentary if you’re interested in football, fame, and the pressures behind a celebrated athlete’s career; Not for you if sports stories feel distant or you want a deeply personal portrait.
review_summary: Pros: compelling rise-and-fall story; varied perspectives; strong college footage | Cons: assumes football interest; limited personal portrait; sometimes feels defensive
